CHAITANYA VADREW

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven Capital Markets Business Analyst with 8+ years translating complex front-to-back trade lifecycle requirements into 
scalable Calypso-based and multi-platform technology solutions across Investment Banking, Wealth Management, and Custody 
operations. Functional expertise spanning Fixed Income, Credit Derivatives (CDS, CLNs), Interest Rate Derivatives (IRS, Swaptions), 
FX Options, Commodity Derivatives, and Equity Derivatives, covering the complete trade lifecycle from order management and 
Front Office Workstation (FOWS) through Calypso WorkStation (CWS), Middle Office, Back Office settlement, reconciliation, NAV, 
and regulatory reporting. Hands-on exposure to Calypso Trading Platform architecture, pricing environments, pricer configuration, 
and workflow/engine customization. Proven delivery of BRD/FRD-driven, UAT-validated production releases using Agile and 
Waterfall methodologies, with measurable STP rate improvements, settlement break reductions, and zero post-deployment 
rollbacks.

Capital Markets | Trade Lifecycle | Settlement | NAV | Corporate Actions | Equity & Fixed Income

pricer measure reconfiguration.

approval workflows, and multi-format reporting (Excel, PDF, text). Supported .xlsb file ingestion and manager-level

• Defined requirements for a cloud-based secure document storage system with role-based retrieval and multi-parameter

• Defined 150+ UAT test scenarios to validate fund value accuracy, NAV alignment, portfolio data completeness, and 
investor-level data segregation across all statement types — collaborating with Data, Operations, Custody, and Technology 
teams to ensure reconciled data feeds published within SLA. 
• Reduced manual statement preparation effort by 60% and eliminated distribution errors by driving automation of the end-
to-end statement generation and dispatch workflow; achieved 100% on-time delivery across all investor communication 
subscription types using Agile delivery methodology.
